The '''Tower of First Knowledge''' was the [[First Knowledge Quarter/Legends|northwestern]] tower surrounding the [[Temple Spire/Legends|Temple Spire]] atop the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[First Knowledge Council Chamber]] was located at the peak of this tower from which they oversaw the operation of the [[Jedi academy]] and [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].

==History==
[[File:Tower_entrance.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The rooftop entrance to the Tower]]
The Tower of First Knowledge was added to the Temple after [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] and served the Order for a brief time before it collapsed during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 1" /> While reconstruction was postponed for several centuries, the Tower was eventually finished during the expansion of [[1019 BBY]]. Serving the Order throughout its next millennium, the Council worked closely with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="SWCL" /> Surrounding the tower's base were several gardens filled with statues and memorial stones. Following the [[New Sith Wars]], a meter-tall block of white stone was inlaid with the five [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilts]] of the Jedi responsible for the defeat of the last [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. In reality, Bane had survived, but Masters [[Valenthyne Farfalla]], [[Worror Dowmat]], and [[Raskta Lsu]], and Knights [[Johun Othone]], [[Sarro Xaj]], and [[Caleb]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] were still memorialized here.<ref name="DB:DOE" />

In [[980 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of [[Doan]] visited the Tower of First Knowledge to pledge to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obba]] the full cooperation of the Doan Royal Family in finding the [[Darth Cognus|assassin]] who killed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]] [[Medd Tandar]].<ref name="DB:DOE" /> Several centuries later, a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] activated for the first time in thirteen generations. Receiving Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in the [[Holocron Chamber]], [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker of First Knowledge]] [[Astaal Vilbum]] revealed the contents of the artifact and their relation to the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]].<ref name="SWR:D">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref>

Surviving the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Tower was ruined when the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] invaded per [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]. Led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] laid waste to the complex, blasting the Tower from the inside and out, reducing many of its interior chambers to rubble and destroying the polished facade.<ref name="ROTS" />

Patrolled by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], the Tower was [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|infiltrated]] by [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], Vader's secret apprentice, as he attempted to complete the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. Entering through the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|main entrance hall]] at the base of the Tower, Starkiller used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to adjust the shattered bridge that spanned the central chasm leading to the Holocron Chamber so that it was passable. Accessing one of the holocrons in the chamber, the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|Gatekeeper]] of the artifact appeared as a [[Kento Marek|hooded figure]] and told him to prepare for his next trial. Starkiller descended into the bowels of the Temple Ziggurat, where he was forced to defeat the [[Sith Warrior (Galen Marek)|Shadow Stalker]], the mirror of his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark emotions]]. Finishing the job, Starkiller left the Temple for the final time, leaving it abandoned once more.<ref name="TFU" />

Standing empty for the next several decades, the Tower eventually crumbled during the disaster involving the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] conquered Coruscant.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> The rest of the Temple crumbled during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], but eventually saw reconstruction under the leadership of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Using blueprints salvaged from the ruined Temple Archives, the [[Reconstruction Authority]] [[New Jedi Temple|rebuilt]] the Ziggurat, towers and all, although they were now concealed behind a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]-and-stone exterior. Whether the Council of First Knowledge was reconvened within the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Jedi Order]] is unknown.<ref name="FOTJO" />

==Layout==
[[File:Jedi_Temple_Central_Status_-TFU.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The central shaft of the Tower, ruined following the events of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]]]
Located on the northwest corner of the Temple, the Tower of First Knowledge was designed to symbolize unity and the steps to enlightenment each Jedi must take. The masonry of the spire was supported by a highly tensile substance known as [[Magnite/Legends|magnite]], which aided in the support of the thin frame of the tower. The tower was crowned by a Council Chamber, like that in each of the other three Council towers of the Temple. Atop the spire was a series of reception/transmission antennas which, along with a constant connection to the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], tapped into the cosmic energy fields of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] itself in order to stay in contact with Jedi on far-flung planets. The central topmast of this unique array of antennas was a powerful multi-frequency [[Eradicator (communications scrambler)|eradicator]]/scrambler that when coupled with the eradicators incorporated into the tower's frame scrambled all communications in and out of the Temple. Communication bundles in the wall cavities fed data from these masts, through the columns within the Council chambers, to the [[High Council holomap room|Operations Planning Center]]. Receiver vanes within the walls of the spire converted signals from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] locations into real-space coordinates before displaying them on the map.<ref name="SWCL" />

Ascending from the base of the tower was a dedicated [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] crafted by great Jedi architects to incorporate Force-inspired, internal dynamics, allowing for the different sizes and shapes of the Order's members to ascend the narrow spire.<ref name="SWCL" /> At the base of tower was a [[Jedi Temple/Legends|reception and entrance hall]] leading from the roof of the Temple Ziggurat into the center of the tower. Two large [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] statues flanked the entrance; their lightsabers crossed over the entry, lifting to allow access to the Tower.<ref name="TFU" /> The hall beyond was dotted with six bronzium statues of long-dead Jedi, with two doors to either side, leading to curved halls. A large memorial statue was held in the cavernous center shaft of the Tower, held by repulsorpads. A bridge spanned the lofty shaft of the tower, passing around the chest of the statue and into the Holocron Chamber on the other side. Near the top of the tower, three Contemplation Stations were spaced evenly from each other to provide a meditative retreat for Jedi preparing to go before the Council.<ref name="SWCL" />

[[File:TowerFirstKnowledge.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] comes to [[Astaal Vilbum]] for information.]]

Off of the main hall were several chambers that encircled the central shaft of the Tower. To the left of the entrance hall was a large [[Jedi Temple Planetarium|planetarium]] made up of giant bronzium globes. In addition to the planetarium, five stone slabs stood in recessed areas with etchings of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] inscribed on them. On the three balconies in the chamber ancient artifacts of the Order were kept behind transparisteel display cases, while [[Heritage tapestry|heritage tapestries]] hung from the ceiling. At the end of the hall was a large memorial to Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]; the semi-circular atrium was lined with stained-glass windows. The hall led into a short passage, underneath which was another hall that led to a balcony overlooking the central shaft of the tower.<ref name="TFU" />

To the right of the entrance hall was a short hallway that led to one of the many training facilities. The chamber had a balcony encompassing the entire area, from which a Jedi Master could observe the training going on below. The floor of the chamber was retractable in order for maintenance to be done on the large [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] below it. Four statues appeared to support the balcony, while in fact, they contained the chamber's stock of [[Jedi training droid/Legends|training droids]]. The droids wielded training lightsabers and were equipped to discharge electrical bursts from their hands, giving users a taste of combat with another Force user. A hallway off the balcony area led to another balcony in the central shaft of the tower.<ref name="TFU" />

Each spire was also equipped with a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] constructed shortly before the Clone Wars. A landing platform extended from the hangar mouth, allowing ships to land on and depart from the Tower's structure. Located fifteen stories below the council chambers, the hangars were connected with a small garage that serviced the spacecraft. Also within the Tower were the chambers and offices of Jedi Council members.<ref name="SWCL" />
